title: Computational Compound Prioritization Strategy Incorporating Docking Variability and Interaction Energies Identifies Putative LRH-1 Binders
summary:
ACS full article Results: prospective 98k compound prioritization, 95 compounds tested and four putative LRH-1 binders (4.2%); single-concentration pilot, no functional co-regulator validation. Claim kept to putative experimental binders. The result is reported in the Journal of Chemical Information
and Modeling. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
